note: Line of sight between navigation-roadmap nodes (indices as in <map>.nav.json), measured by exact segment/triangle tests against the map's solid, opaque geometry at eye height. One bit per unordered pair (i < j), upper triangle row-major, MSB first; 1 = visible. Pairs beyond rangeUnits were not tested and are 0.

params.occluders: solid, opaque triangles (foliage, wires, decals, clear glass removed)
